notes.title: Reverse Crawl Update! v1.0.0.3
notes.content:
Hey guys, I've uploaded the third update for Reverse Crawl: 

Changelog v 1.0.0.3
================ 

- Fixed the Cache mission and remaining Siren bugs. 
- Added an Upgrade Tree. Accessible from the main quest screen and after missions, it allows you to have greater control over your upgrades and specializations. Each level up grants you points that you can spend in one of six upgrade categories!
- Rebalanced the Endless mode to scale better over time.

Mini update (15 Oct)
- Fixed Marksman level 1 in the Upgrade Tree.
- Reworked New Game+ a little: all heroes are now available from the start (except for the final two classes), and the hero missions have been reworked/removed in New Game+

As always, if you come across any new bugs or have some feedback, head along to the community forums and let me know! Thanks guys!

notes.title: Reverse Crawl Update! v1.0.0.2
notes.content:
Hey guys, I've uploaded the second update for Reverse Crawl:

Changelog v 1.0.0.2
================

- Guard command nerfed. It now heals less damage, and damage reduction from the next missile is reduced to 35% from 50% originally.
- Reworked the "Threatening" trait to only trigger with a 15% chance each round. It was way too powerful before, and has been toned down now.
- Reworked the "Holy Light" ability, it now only has a 33% chance to reduce 1 Threat, instead of 100% chance of reducing Threat by 2 originally.
- Fixed Cache mission: choosing Violet early will no longer make the mission unwinnable
- Fixed Siren bug: having no enemies remaining when dominated will no longer freeze the game
- You can now alt-tab out of the game without it crashing.
- Various smaller bug fixes.

As always, if you come across any new bugs or have some feedback, head along to the community forums and let me know! Thanks guys!

notes.title: Reverse Crawl Update! v1.0.0.1
notes.content:
Hey guys, I've uploaded the first update for Reverse Crawl:

Changelog v 1.0.0.1
================

- You can now use the Guard command even when Stunned, so that you can always skip a turn by Guarding instead. It can even be used if there is a Magehunter on the field.
- Fixed Sirens so that a dominated creature's turn automatically ends when there are no enemies left on the field.

I've got bigger changes planned in future updates, so stay tuned! In the meantime, keep leaving reviews if you enjoy the game, take some screenshots, and feel free to ask questions on the discussion boards. Cheers!
